official_platform_clock_evidence.claim: FTMO lists MetaTrader 4 and MetaTrader 5 platform server time as GMT+2 plus daylight saving time.
FTMO describes MT platform time as GMT+2 until the US DST change on 2025-03-09, then GMT+3.
FTMO describes MT platform time as GMT+3 through 2025-11-02, then GMT+2 after the US DST change.
FTMO again documents GMT+2 before, and GMT+3 after, the US DST change in 2026.

affected_code: quant_rl/features/session_ohlc.py converts the fixed-offset index to America/Chicago for CT session windows.

implementation.method: For CT feature conversion, subtract seven hours from the recorded FTMO server wall time, localize the resulting New York wall time with America/New_York rules, then convert to the requested session timezone. Ambiguous or nonexistent source wall times fail closed.
